positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
• On-road Monitoring team responsible for providing real-time visibility into Driver Delivery Execution for operators around the globe through location-based dashboard web-app
• Incorporated visibility of drivers breaks, including current break status, duration, location, etc
• A first step to addressing the issue of drivers sacrificing break time to complete planned routes, as well as reports of drivers' lack of washroom breaks
• Tech stack React, Java and AWS
positions.insights: React.js, Amazon Web Services (AWS) and +1 skill

positions.title: DevOps Developer
positions.description:
• Developed regex filters for Logstash container to direct syslogs to Elasticsearch
• Subsequently set up anomaly detection for applications and pipeline
microservices based on the syslog documents by using machine learning
analysis and configured watchers to push anomalies to PagerDuty
• Saved hours of downtime and teams’ effort to communicate their respective
pipeline/application failures
• Created automated integration testing for Jenkins Shared Library by running
in-house testing framework in a Jenkins pipeline, reducing hours of manual
testing every time new feature is added to shared library
• Modified/Wrote Microservices using RabbitMQ in CI/CD pipeline to support newer/existing pipelines
• Setup and wrote configuration for nginx reverse proxy for microservices and
deployed as containerized application
• Setup VMs as nodes for.NET Application builds for Azure Jenkins pipeline
• Monthly rotation in support for Jira tickets related to DevOps issues for other
teams

positions.title: Back End Developer
positions.description:
• Backend Lead in creating RESTful API for a cross platform mobile based Opioid
Overdose Prevention Application for the University Health Network in Toronto
• Valued at $60,000 dollars, application originally scheduled for beta testing with
patients for safety injection sites in mid-2020 in Toronto
• Application prevents overdoses by using a timer and alerts nearby responders
with Naloxone kits if patient does not end the timer after a period of time
• Created endpoints for login/signup, online status toggling, add/search/remove
responders, location, etc 
• Created as a part of Code The Change Foundation, a registered non-profit

courses.name: APSC 160 - Introduction to Computation in Engineering
APSC 377 - Nuclear Weapons and Arms Control

honors.title: Best use of Google Cloud API award
honors.description:
• Won 3rd place in best use of Google Cloud API award in 2020 nwHacks
• Uses Google Vision API to detect stop signs and uses sonarto
determine distance using Raspberry Pi camera, then uses
Text-to-Speech API to broadcast distance and information of presence
of stop sign to alert useris near a curb to the user using an earpiece
• Designed to help people with visual disabilities

honors.title: First place award in 2019 BC Health and Regenerative Medicine Hackathon
honors.description:
• Created assisting device for quadriplegic client that works in real estate
to control aerial drone for surveying in team of five
• Blowing into device allows the drone to elevate and moving joystick with
mouth maneuvers it from side to side
• Firmware lead responsible forrevamping Arduino C firmware of
LipSync – mouth based assisting device for mouse control and created
relay circuit
• Won first place in the two week long 2019 BC Health and Regenerative
Medicine Hackathon
honors.issuer: Issued by 2019 BC Health and Regenerative Medicine Hackathon · Sep 2019

projects.title: End to End Road Deterioration Detection for Telus
Copilot - Visual Impairment Assistive device
projects.description:
• Made with Raspberry Pi and won 3rd place in best use of Google Cloud API award in 2020 nwHacks
 • Uses Google Vision API to detect stop signs and uses sonar to determine distance, then uses Text-to-Speech API to broadcast distance and information of presence of stop sign to alert user is near curb of a street
